properties.title: Florida Coral Reef Restoration
properties.description: Restoring the Florida Reef Tract through outplanting of climate-resilient coral fragments to enhance biodiversity and coastal protection.

properties.title: California Kelp Forest Recovery
properties.description: Monitoring and restoring giant kelp forests along the California coast by removing invasive urchins and outplanting kelp spores.

properties.title: Gulf of Mexico Marine Mammal Protection
properties.description: Implementing acoustic monitoring and vessel speed reduction zones to protect endangered Rice's whales in the Gulf of Mexico.

properties.title: Hawaii Sea Turtle Bycatch Reduction
properties.description: Working with local fisheries to implement circle hooks and LED deterrents to significantly reduce sea turtle bycatch.

properties.title: Galapagos Marine Reserve Expansion
properties.description: Supporting the creation of the Hermandad Marine Reserve to protect migratory corridors for sharks and sea turtles.

properties.title: Great Barrier Reef Resilience
properties.description: Funding research into heat-tolerant Symbiodiniaceae to inoculate corals against bleaching events in the Great Barrier Reef.

properties.title: Arabian Gulf Dugong Conservation
properties.description: Mapping seagrass habitats and establishing protected zones to safeguard the world's second-largest dugong population.

properties.title: Mediterranean Posidonia Protection
properties.description: Deploying eco-friendly mooring systems to prevent anchor damage to vital Posidonia oceanica seagrass meadows.

properties.title: Reef Recovery Marseille
properties.description: Installing artificial 3D-printed reefs to restore marine biodiversity in the Calanques National Park.

properties.title: Atlantic Coast Mangrove Restoration
properties.description: Community-led mangrove reforestation projects in West Africa to sequester carbon and provide nursery habitats for fish.

properties.title: Brittany Marine Litter Reduction
properties.description: Supporting local NGOs to clean up ghost nets and plastic pollution from the Brittany coastline.

properties.title: Bermuda Sargasso Sea Protection
properties.description: Advocating for the high seas protection of the Sargasso Sea, a critical nursery for eels and sea turtles.

properties.title: Right Whale Acoustic Monitoring
properties.description: Deploying underwater gliders to detect North Atlantic right whales and alert shipping vessels to prevent strikes.

properties.title: Mesoamerican Reef Conservation
properties.description: Strengthening marine protected areas and sustainable fishing practices along the Mesoamerican Reef.

properties.title: Bali Manta Ray Protection
properties.description: Establishing community-managed marine protected areas to safeguard manta ray cleaning stations in Indonesia.

properties.title: Madagascar Shark Sanctuary
properties.description: Working with local communities to establish a shark sanctuary and transition away from destructive fishing gears.

properties.title: Philippines Coral Bleaching Response
properties.description: Developing a rapid response network to monitor and mitigate coral bleaching events in the Coral Triangle.

properties.title: Galapagos Penguin Conservation
properties.description: Building artificial nesting sites to boost the population of the endangered Galapagos penguin.

properties.title: Martinique Coral Restoration
properties.description: Restoring Acropora corals in Martinique using micro-fragmentation techniques to accelerate growth.

properties.title: Singapore Strait Plastic Cleanup
properties.description: Deploying autonomous solar-powered vessels to collect plastic waste from the busy Singapore Strait.
